projects.description:
Built a lightweight, fully functional Markdown-to-HTML parser from scratch, implementing **recursive backtracking algorithms** and a **custom regex engine** to intelligently handle both line-based and inline syntax without external libraries.
###   **Key Features & Technical Challenges:**
*   Developed a **recursive token handling system** supporting deeply nested Markdown elements (e.g., bold within italic, lists within lists).
*   Designed and implemented a **custom regex-based grammar engine** for precise detection and processing of diverse Markdown syntax (bold, italic, links, images, etc.).
*   Engineered robust parsing for complex structures including **multi-level nested lists** (ordered/unordered), **code blocks** with preserved formatting, **tables** (header/row parsing), and custom expressions (image titles, link metadata).
*   Successfully managed parsing complexities by developing separate logic for **line-level blocks** and **inline tokens**, utilizing dynamic pointer tracking for recursive boundary management.
###   **Core Algorithms & Implementation:**
*   Utilized a **pointer-based recursive word parser** for character-by-character content analysis, ensuring accurate handling of deeply nested expressions.
*   Implemented an **indentation-aware custom list renderer** with tab depth tracking for generating semantically correct nested HTML lists.
*   Developed a **dynamic table parser** that intelligently splits rows/columns, discards alignment syntax, and converts markdown tables into clean HTML.
*   **Impact & Application:** Provides a performant and dependency-free solution for embedding markdown parsing in web applications, CMS/blog engines, developer documentation sites, and lightweight editors (React/Vanilla JS environments), showcasing deep understanding of language parsing, regex design, and stateful recursive algorithms.
*   **Tech Stack:** **TypeScript/JavaScript**, Custom Regex Engine, Recursive Backtracking Algorithms, Modular Parsing Utilities.

projects.description:
** Developed **Lattize**, a comprehensive Chrome DevTools extension designed to provide developers with in-depth website performance metrics, DOM insights, and network analysis, leveraging a wide array of **Chrome APIs**.
### **Key Features & Technical Challenges:**
*   Implemented real-time monitoring and reporting of critical performance metrics: **Total Nodes Rendered, Memory Consumption (RAM), System Specs (CPU, Cores), Average FPS on Repaint, Core Web Vitals (FCP, LCP, TBT)**.
*   Engineered a **DOM Tree Visualizer** that maps element dependencies to CSS and API calls, including **maximum depth analysis** and **parsing times for HTML (DOM) & CSS (CSSOM)**.
*   Developed a **simultaneous network request visualizer** detailing API call specifics (timing, blocking status, cached responses, data consumed) by deeply integrating with `chrome.webRequests`.
*   Integrated features for **SEO analysis** (OG tag preview across social platforms), **security violation detection**, and **accessibility recommendations**.
### **Core Implementation & Chrome API Usage:**
*   Extensively utilized Chrome APIs including `chrome.processes` (memory, CPU), `chrome.system.cpu`, `chrome.webRequests` (network monitoring), `chrome.dom` (DOM traversal - *conceptual, actual DOM access is via content scripts*), `chrome.performance` (Core Web Vitals), and `chrome.storage` (settings).
*   Designed the extension architecture to efficiently collect, process, and present complex data within the DevTools panel interface.
*   Challenged by asynchronous data collection from multiple APIs and presenting it in a synchronized, user-friendly manner.
*   **Impact & Application:** Empowers developers with a powerful, integrated tool to diagnose performance bottlenecks, optimize resource loading, improve SEO, and enhance web accessibility directly within their development workflow.

projects.shortDescription: A minimal, fast, and distraction-free text editor built for the web. Perfect for taking quick notes, writing drafts, or capturing ideas on the go — all with seamless cloud storage.
projects.description:
Created **Ideal Editor**, a fast, distraction-free, web-based text editor focused on core writing functionalities, featuring seamless cloud/local storage and innovative data structures for efficient text manipulation.
### **Key Features & Technical Challenges:**
*   Implemented a comprehensive set of text editing features: file/folder management, image support, focus mode, **AI-powered word suggestions**, and rich text formatting (headings, lists, code, tables).
*   Designed and built core editor functionalities from scratch, including complex cursor movements, multi-level selection (character, line, block), copy/paste, undo/redo, and search, ensuring a responsive user experience.
*   Developed a **virtualized line rendering** system to efficiently handle large documents and maintain performance.
*   Integrated **cloud and local storage options** for seamless data persistence and accessibility.
### **Core Algorithms & Data Structures:**
*   Architected the editor's core using a **custom N-Array Tree data structure with LinkedList pointers** (`Line` and `Letter` classes) for efficient storage and manipulation of text at character and line levels.
*   Developed modular algorithms for all fundamental text operations (insertion, deletion, cursor movement, selection) directly manipulating this custom data structure.
*   Tackled the complexity of maintaining consistent editor state and cursor positioning across diverse editing operations and keyboard shortcuts.
*   **Impact & Application:** Offers a lightweight, performant alternative to traditional text editors for quick note-taking, drafting, and idea capture, showcasing advanced data structure implementation and algorithm design for a core computing problem.

** Developed **Gamuts**, an intuitive web-based tool enabling users to quickly sketch diagrams with a hand-drawn feel and transform them into polished, professional-looking visuals, featuring an infinite canvas and diverse editing capabilities.
### **Key Features & Technical Challenges:**
*   Implemented a rich set of drawing tools: **free-hand drawing, pre-defined shapes (circles, rectangles, polygons, lines, arrows)** with extensive customization options (style, color, stroke, fill, rotation, reshaping).
*   Engineered an **infinite canvas** with smooth zooming and panning, supporting complex object manipulation including grouping, layering, and connections between shapes.
*   Integrated text and image support with advanced editing features: font styling, image filters (blur, HUE, saturation), cropping, and resizing.
*   Designed a **video editing mode** with scene creation, timeline management, and frame-by-frame animation capabilities, exporting to MP4.
### **Core Implementation & Architecture:**
*   Utilized a canvas rendering library (e.g., **Konva.js, Fabric.js, or native Canvas API** - *specify which one if used*) to manage and render graphical objects and interactions.
*   Architected a modular system with distinct components: `ToolBar`, `Zoomer`, `ExportControls`, `OptionsBar` (contextual to selected shape), and `Undo/Redo` manager.
*   Addressed challenges in managing complex state for numerous objects on an infinite canvas, implementing efficient hit detection, selection, and transformation logic.
*   **Impact & Application:** Provides a versatile and user-friendly platform for creating a wide range of visual content, from simple sketches and diagrams to more complex illustrations and animated presentations, demonstrating skills in 2D graphics, UI/UX for creative tools, and complex state management.

projects.shortDescription: A text based distraction-free personal space for connecting with your closed circles.
projects.description:
** Built **Circles**, a distraction-free, text-only social application designed for connecting with close friends, emphasizing privacy, real-time communication, and secure interactions.
### **Key Features & Technical Challenges:**
*   Developed core social features: user signup/login (with **reCAPTCHA v3**), friend request system (add/reject/delete/block), profile management (auto-generated avatars, status, last seen).
*   Implemented real-time 1:1 and group chat functionalities using **WebSockets**, including message actions (reply, delete, star, pin, react), lazy loading of history, and typing indicators.
*   Designed and integrated a basic **End-to-End Encryption** mechanism for 1:1 chats using public/private key pairs to enhance message privacy.
*   Focused on security with **rate limiting** for API calls and ensured all secured API interactions utilized auth tokens managed via cookies.
### **Core Architecture & Backend Implementation:**
*   Utilized a **Next.js (App Router)** frontend with middleware for auth and cookie management, hosted on Vercel.
*   Planned a backend with **GraphQL/REST API** options, **Socket.IO** (or similar) for real-time bidirectional communication, and **MongoDB (M0 Serverless)** for data persistence, intended for an **EC2 instance**.
*   Tackled challenges in managing real-time connections, synchronizing state across clients, and implementing a secure authentication and authorization flow.
*   **Impact & Application:** Offers a minimalist and secure platform for private text-based communication, showcasing abilities in full-stack development, real-time application architecture, basic cryptography implementation, and secure API design.
